correspondence: One finite current content, projection or same-page restore intent interleaved with one current read and one external writer. Separate owner readiness/Operation from local/Record finite intent. Safety plus conditional progress; no claim of distributed CAS or complete management verification.
review_basis: Reviewed current operation activation, never-replay unknown action, non-content owner qualification and current snapshot final consumption fence. Projection and same-page restore preserve the real owner readiness. Existing production tests are replayed by removing each named guard in isolated copies. The source hashes below bind the actual inspected input, not an implementation refinement proof. Reviewed upstream 2c2c76a3 against 14b93dc6: restoration reads exact owner metadata and Source contributions before untrash, because a relation to a trashed owner hides still-live Files rows. Full directory validation remains after restoration. The projection regression now reproduces hidden relation rows, seeds prior projection for resume cases, and rejects changed main Content or Source contribution on retry. These fixture/restore boundaries do not change the four modeled kernel guards or the seven case inventories; the bounded model does not prove Notion relation visibility. Reviewed the native terminal-LF admission change against fc0999f4: this protected projection regression changes only two successful native input literals to omit their final LF. The authoritative writer still compares complete observed body text exactly and preserves unknown outcomes; no lifecycle kernel or snapshot guard changed. Native representation admission and actual Notion Markdown rendering are outside this finite model. The seven case inventories and four real guard mutations are unchanged.

CurrentLifecycle.bounds: One owner with two abstract content identities; one finite intent of fixed kind content/projection/restore; one non-idempotent product action with known/unknown accepted/unknown absent outcomes; at most one foreign writer; one current read; dispatch count 0..2.
CurrentLifecycle.assumptions: Metadata/body/dispatch/observation actions eventually return. Weak fairness covers operation dispatch, an explicitly requested exact resume, verification/finalization/retirement and an already-started read. Without these assumptions the model makes no eventual-success claim. Unknown absent ends in an explained blocked state with the intent retained.
CurrentLifecycle.scope: A ready owner has no content Operation while projection/restore may retain a separate finite intent. Completion qualification records the state at completion; a later writer does not retroactively invalidate a completed read. Same-page restore abstracts Trash as one bit and shares readiness guards; exact page identity, policy, budgets, physical retirement and Source parent/child cursors remain production regressions.

implementation_bindings.name: current_read_publication
implementation_bindings.scope: The final owner readiness check and consumptionFence reject a writer that started or completed during body/provider acquisition. Equality abstracts the complete production fence. This is a change detector, not a lock or cross-owner transaction.

implementation_bindings.name: finite_intent_separate_from_content_owner
implementation_bindings.scope: preserveReadyOwner distinguishes projection/restore from authoritative writes; a precise non-ready owner blocks their completion. A never-replay action with an unobservable prior result retains its intent. The model's blocked state is an explained stop, not automatic recovery.

unmodeled_bindings.scope: Physical Notion IDs and duplicate detection, current policy/input schemas and upgrades, multipart/file transfer, Source child ordering, arbitrary files/owners, remote request latency, SQLite crash/locking, permanent history, natural language and Pi/provider behavior are not enumerated.

maintenance.routing: Current lifecycle production/guard/test/model/input changes run this complete suite and its real guard mutations. The request-engine suite remains independently selectable.
maintenance.model_semantics: Review each finite bound, atomic observation and fairness assumption. Positive and intentional negative configurations use the same independent rule inventory. Hash changes require actual diff review; they do not constitute a proof.
